title: 進路セミナーⅡ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar II
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Improve their character building using their own ideals. (2) Apply themselves to a profession as engineers who have ningenryoku (in Japanese) and improve their strengths as innovators and who can think and act for themselves. (3) Establish their own goals for going on to graduate school or finding a job as a plan for their career.
advice: We will cover the following based on student's self-check, self-reflection, and career planning: 1. Introduction to graduate school and various companies 2. Self-check and analysis 3. Practice exam: Synthetic Personality Inventory (SPI) 4. Special presentations by professional human resource managers and graduate students 5. Others Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are expected to check for various messages and materials in class. Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts.
books: Textbooks: None specified Reference books: None specified Reserved books: None specified
requiredKnowledge: Career Planning Seminar II is a required course aimed at helping students going on to graduate school or finding jobs. Therefore, all students are required to attend regardless of own study continuation plans.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain your own career planning and method for realizing it
Be able to do career planning actively while using the information it requires
Be able to assess your own knowledge, ability, skill, and qualifications as needed to determine a career plan
